sentences.en: I think you're partly to blame for the negotiation breakdown.
sentences.zh: 我认为谈判破裂你也有部分责任。

sentences.en: We decided not to have peace negotiations with the invaders.
sentences.zh: 我们决定不与入侵者进行和平谈判。

sentences.en: Our negotiations to lower export taxes suffered a big setback.
sentences.zh: 我们降低出口税的谈判遭遇了重大挫折。
